description:
## Current scope
All previously inventoried published bundles predate two generator changes, including cloud bundles. The target is current-generator consistency or explicit old-data segregation, not matching obsolete cloud counts. Reconcile the live bundle inventory before planning reruns.

## Historical finding (retained for provenance)
The published TPC-DI cohorts mix two data versions. The cloud bundles (BigQuery, Snowflake and Databricks at SF 0.1, 1 and 10) were loaded after the generator change in #2220 (`cac8582a0`). They agree on all sixteen table row counts and on QVQ12/QAQ7 result counts: 100/1 at SF 0.1, 32/2 at SF 1, 1/1 at SF 10. The local TPC-DI bundles in the corpus predate that change and report QVQ12=9 and QAQ7=1 at SF 1. So local and cloud timings in the same cohort are measured over different data. results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md section "TPC-DI cloud data comparison (2026-10-03)" discloses this.

## Decision gates
First settle remaining TPC-DI specification differences and standard-scale policy (needs below). Owner must approve a named cloud matrix and spend limit before nine cloud reruns, or choose explicit old-generator disclosure/exclusion. Inventory live bundles: the historical claim of 24 bundles and the stated local platform/scale breakdown do not reconcile arithmetically; do not invent missing cohorts.

## Verification rubric
Pass: inventory every existing bundle by platform, scale, generator version, seed, row counts and ranking status. Regenerated bundles use one approved generator and seed 42; compare row counts and QVQ12/QAQ7 counts only between same-generator runs. For cloud runs not approved, record owner-selected old-data disposition and prevent misleading cross-generator comparisons. Validate replacement/supersession and rendered cohort disclosure. Fail: matching new local results to obsolete cloud counts.

## Additional guardrails
No cloud spend without current approval. Never edit immutable bundles in place or treat this tracker update as publication approval. Keep outstanding cloud coverage owned here if only local reruns land.
